items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: This piece actually, “Ebony,” Ahmad recorded, piece of mine that he recorded on one of his records.

ctx.x: That one was a good piece, which I played piano (on), again this is where I overdubbed piano and then drums because I felt it would add something to the piece. This piece actually, “Ebony,” Ahmad recorded, piece of mine that he recorded on one of his records.
I hope you’re getting some royalties for that!
